- The root cause: `out/` is generated by `gen.py` from `models.json`, which still said `131072`. Someone had hand-edited `out/opencode.json` to 262144, so it drifted from the other two, and the next `python gen.py` run would have put it back to 131072.
- I changed the source of truth: `models.json` line 3 now has `"context_window": 262144` for fast-coder.
- I reran `python gen.py`. All three files in `out/` are rewritten from `models.json`, so the next regeneration keeps 262144 too.

**[result]**
- Generator output: `wrote out/opencode.json`, `wrote out/codex.toml`, `wrote out/claude.json`.
- All three now read 262144:
  - `out/claude.json:5`: `"contextWindow": 262144,`
  - `out/codex.toml:2`: `context_window = 262144`
  - `out/opencode.json:9`: `"context": 262144,`
- I diffed `out/` before and after. Only two lines changed: `131072` became `262144` in `claude.json` and in `codex.toml`. Regenerating `opencode.json` changed nothing, so the hand edit was its only difference from the generator, and every other model setting is the same as before.
- Assumption: 262144 comes from your brief. I did not check it against the model server.

**[next]** None needed. Future changes go in `models.json`, then run `python gen.py`; don't edit `out/` by hand. No browser tabs or apps were opened. The only scratch copy I made was in the temp folder, and I deleted it.
